date_note: Date of AEON Smart Technology's announcement as given by ScanNetSecurity, which published on 19 Nov; the company's notice PDF could not be read.
title: AEON group websites: 414 customer records leaked after unauthorized access, AEON Smart Technology says
summary: According to ScanNetSecurity, AEON Co. detected third-party unauthorized access to some websites on 20 October, and AEON Smart Technology announced on 10 November that files in an affected system were leaked. It says 414 customer records (names, addresses, phone numbers) from 2024 summer-gift orders at four stores were involved. The company says it will notify customers in turn and strengthen security with an external firm.
plain: ScanNetSecurity reports that AEON group says names, addresses and phone numbers of 414 customers leaked after unauthorized access to some websites.
exec: AEON Smart Technology says 414 customers' contact details leaked; a small incident at a large retail group.
action: Affected customers should wait for the company's individual notice and be alert to phishing calls or mail that use their name and address.

validation.note: Only ScanNetSecurity was read. The company's notice (aeon-st.co.jp, AST261110.pdf) loaded but its text could not be extracted, so the figures are not checked against it.
